title: Beetle God Ritual
description: A large demonic beetle with antlers and glowing white eyes hovers above a mound of bones and skulls. Below, a circle of robed cultists kneel in worship around a central horned figure, all enclosed by a glowing zodiac ring with floating golden symbols above.
prompt: A massive demonic beetle with antlers and glowing white eyes floats above a mound of bones and skulls in a black void. Below it, a group of black-robed cultists kneel in a circle around a central horned figure holding a staff, all surrounded by a large glowing golden zodiac wheel. Floating golden circular symbols hover above the beetle, high contrast black and white line art with golden accents, dark fantasy style.
